en: Vintage multi-view black-and-white postcard titled "Oradea – Băile Felix," showing the Băile Felix spa resort near Oradea: crowded outdoor thermal pools, timbered spa buildings with steep roofs, landscaped gardens, and a small footbridge over water. The reverse has a handwritten Romanian message dated July 13, 1968, a Romanian 40 bani postage stamp (Aniversari Culturale – Aron Pumnul), postal cancellations, and an address.
